```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find monochrome rectangular frames and their interior patterns.
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        # Keep only complete rectangular outlines.
        if all(grid[r0][c] == color and grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and \
           all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1)):
            pat = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pat))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    patterned = [f for f in frames if any(any(row) for row in f[5])]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pat in frames:
        if any(any(row) for row in pat) or not patterned:
            continue
        # Use the nonempty pattern with the closest interior dimensions.
        source = min(patterned, key=lambda f: abs((f[2]-f[1]-1)-(r1-r0-1)) + abs((f[4]-f[3]-1)-(c1-c0-1)))
        sp = source[5]
        th, tw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        sh, sw = len(sp), len(sp[0])
        for i in range(th):
            for j in range(tw):
                si = min(sh-1, i*sh//th)
                sj = min(sw-1, j*sw//tw)
                if sp[si][sj]:
                    out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] = color
    return out
```
